title: Reservation Deposits, Hold Periods and Community Fees — Independent Living Price Sheet
content:
These are the reservation and one-time community fee figures for each apartment type offered under the Independent Living Residency Agreement. Amounts are in US dollars; periods are in calendar days.

## Reservation figures

| Apartment type | Reservation deposit | Longest hold (reservation date to planned move-in) | Full-refund window after reservation | Refund on a later cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 1,000.00 | 30 days | 14 days | 50% of the deposit received |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 1,000.00 | 30 days | 14 days | 50% |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 1,500.00 | 45 days | 14 days | 50% |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 1,500.00 | 45 days | 14 days | 50% |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 2,000.00 | 45 days | 14 days | 50% |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 2,500.00 | 60 days | 14 days | 50% |

Deposit figures written plainly: 1000.00, 1000.00, 1500.00, 1500.00, 2000.00 and 2500.00.

## One-time community fees

| Apartment type | Community fee, first resident | Community fee, second occupant |
|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 2,750.00 | 0.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 3,250.00 | 1,250.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 3,500.00 | 1,250.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 3,950.00 | 1,500.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 4,250.00 | 1,500.00 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 5,100.00 | 1,750.00 |

Community fee figures written plainly: first resident 2750.00, 3250.00, 3500.00, 3950.00, 4250.00, 5100.00; second occupant 0.00, 1250.00, 1250.00, 1500.00, 1500.00, 1750.00.

## Meaning of each figure

- **Reservation deposit** — the deposit taken when the apartment is reserved; it is held and applied to the first charges at move-in.
- **Longest hold** — the maximum number of calendar days from the reservation date to the planned move-in date.
- **Full-refund window** — the number of calendar days after the reservation date during which a cancellation receives a full deposit refund.
- **Refund on a later cancellation** — the percentage of the reservation deposit refunded when a reservation is cancelled after the full-refund window.
- **Community fee, first resident** — the one-time, non-refundable fee charged for the first resident at move-in.
- **Community fee, second occupant** — the one-time, non-refundable fee charged for a second occupant, at move-in or when the second occupant is added; 0.00 where a second occupant is not permitted.

## Example (hypothetical)

For an Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe reserved on a given day, the deposit is 2,000.00, the planned move-in date may be at most 45 calendar days after the reservation date, and a later cancellation refunds 50 percent of the deposit received.
